global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (highlighted headline line, round seal), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226 (headline text, bottom strip), bottle black #0E0E10, white #FFFFFF (icon strokes, strip text), seal gold #D4A437 only for the registration badge border. global_identity.visual_style: Real photographic still life with soft natural light, the bottle studio-sharp in the center over a blurred Amazon forest, plus a small real photo card.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Natural, fresh and convincing: the three ingredients are the missing support for her routine.
global_identity.graphic_language: Mint circles with thin white line icons, short steel-grey labels, a fuchsia scalloped round seal, a rounded white-bordered photo card, a slim plum strip with a white pill and a gold-bordered badge.

creative_objective: Explain why this time it works: her gym routine lacked the support of three ingredients. Show the real ingredients around the bottle, her frustration with loose jeans after the gym and her result on another day.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline with 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' in fuchsia; 2) the bottle in the center; 3) the before/after card; 4) the four ingredient icons; 5) the ingredients on the wood; 6) the bottom strip.
art_direction.composition_style: Like the structure: centered headline and paragraph on top, bottle in the center with a round seal near its cap, icons two on the right side and two on the left; on the left the upper icon position is taken by the before/after photo card and the two left icons sit stacked below it; ingredients on the wooden table at the bottom; slim strip at the very bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top 0-24% headline and value proposition; middle 24-76% card (left 3-33%, 25-52%), left icons (3-33%, 54-76%), bottle (35-65%), right icons (68-97%); 76-88% ingredients on the wood; 88-100% strip.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft warm natural sunlight from the upper left through the forest, gentle rim light on the bottle, soft contact shadows on the wood, background in strong bokeh.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Blurred green Amazon forest background. Top (0-24%): one centered two-line headline in dark plum with the second line in fuchsia, and a centered value proposition paragraph in steel grey. Middle: the real bottle in the center, a round fuchsia scalloped seal near its cap; four mint icon circles with labels around it (two on the right stacked, two on the left stacked lower), and on the upper left a rounded photo card with the before and after of the same woman. Bottom: a light wooden table with aguaje fruits, fenugreek seeds and black maca roots at the base of the bottle; then a slim plum strip with the offer, 'Pagas al recibir' and the gold-bordered badge.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium botanical still-life ad. BACKGROUND: a lush Amazon rainforest in strong soft bokeh, deep greens and warm sunlit patches, slightly lighter at the top so dark text reads clearly. TOP ZONE (0-24%): a centered headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, two lines: 'TU RUTINA PEDÍA' in dark plum #2B1226 and the highlighted line 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' in hot fuchsia #E6177F. Under it (17-24%), a centered two-line paragraph in Poppins SemiBold, steel grey #4A5560: 'Cola con forma y piernas torneadas desde la semana 4 de tu plan, para que por fin se note tu esfuerzo.' MIDDLE ZONE (24-76%): CENTER (35-65% of the width, 26-82% of the height): the attached product standing upright on the table, front view, about 50% of the canvas height, camera slightly high (15 degrees), 50 mm lens; use the attached product image as the only source of truth and do not redesign it: a matte black cylindrical bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides, wide mouth and no neck, a glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body (about 90%) and one fifth of its height with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth, black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and three boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'; the label front-facing and readable; not a slim bottle, not a squat jar; closed, never mirrored; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; no capsules anywhere. Near the upper right of the cap, a round hot fuchsia #E6177F scalloped seal with a thin white inner ring and white Poppins Bold text '2 CÁPSULAS AL DÍA'. RIGHT SIDE (68-97% of the width): two mint green #7ED6B5 circles stacked at 30-48% and 54-72% of the height, each with a thin white line icon (a scaly round palm fruit; small seeds with a leaf) and under each a short centered label in Poppins Bold steel grey #4A5560: 'Aguaje 200 mg' and 'Fenogreco 400 mg'. LEFT SIDE: upper part (3-33% of the width, 25-52% of the height): a rounded photo card with a white border and soft shadow, split in two side-by-side real unretouched photos of the SAME adult Colombian woman, 24 years old, light wheat skin with visible pores, thick eyebrows, black hair, framed head to mid-thigh, on two DIFFERENT DAYS, with tiny tags 'Antes' and 'Semana 4'. BEFORE photo: a gym locker room under cold fluorescent light, black hair in a low messy bun, a grey gym t-shirt and loose light-blue jeans pulled on after training; side-on at hip height with her face to the camera and a frustrated sigh, her hand pulls the back waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap is clearly visible; flat straight hips, glutes flat with no curve, thin straight thighs. AFTER photo: an outdoor park path in golden early-morning sun, black hair in a high ponytail, a mint #7ED6B5 sports top and steel-grey #4A5560 leggings, three-quarter pose facing the camera with a proud smile; small waist, hips clearly wider and rounded, toned fuller thighs; clear change, natural. Lower part (3-33% of the width, 54-76%): two mint circles side by side, each with a thin white line icon (a twisted dark root; a small droplet with a leaf) and short labels in Poppins Bold steel grey: 'Maca negra 200 mg' and 'Vitaminas A y E'. BOTTOM ZONE (76-88%): a light natural wooden table with real ingredients around the base of the bottle: three reddish-brown scaly aguaje fruits (one cut showing orange flesh) on the left, a small wooden bowl and a scatter of golden fenugreek seeds in front, and dark knobby black maca roots on the right, soft contact shadows. BOTTOM STRIP (88-100%): a slim full-width dark plum #2B1226 strip with, left to right: white Poppins Bold 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses', a white pill with plum Poppins Bold 'Pagas al recibir', and a round badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, plum center and white text 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.
